notes.title: Release is coming soon! Card battler AND memory game? Yes, Indeed.
notes.notes:
The countdown has officially begun, and we can’t wait for you all to dive into the unique mix of card battling and memory game that we’ve crafted with love and care.

[h2]Mark Your Calendars!
[/h2]

The game will be available on August 28th at the following times:

09:00 AM (EDT, New York)
15:00 (EEST, Finland)
21:00 (CST, Beijing)

[h2]Join Us for Daily Developer Streams!
[/h2]

As we gear up for launch day, we want to hang out with you and give you a sneak peek into the world of Lost Mastery! Starting Wed Aug 21st, we’ll be streaming every day at 6:00 PM Finnish time (EEST) until release.

Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or just curious about the game, grab your favorite snack, settle in, and join us as we count down the days to launch together.

[h2]Get Ready for Adventure!
[/h2]
We can’t wait to see how you master the blend of strategy and memory as you build your decks, master combos, buy out the shop and uncover the mystery.

See you on August 28th! 🚀

All the best,
Lost Mastery Team
